scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm install --prefix backend && npm run check --prefix backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:local: npm run check --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
